title: Tendency
subtitle: Old Habits Never Die
text: Blood Tendency is the elemental alignment of your blood, shaped by the creatures you slay. There are eight tendencies: Vivacious, Fervent, Frigid, Ruinous, Incandescent, Umbral, Neurotic, and Ferric. Each manipulation has a tendency affinity, and aligning your blood improves its potency. Use Enzymes to nudge your tendency in the desired direction.
